page.layout: Running head across the top, centred, with the page number 85 at the right. One block of text below it, set in a narrow column, with date numerals at the right margin beside the first two lines. Below the text: the closing words "Finis Libri Primi." and a decorative ornament, with no text. At the foot: a signature "L 3" at left and a catchword "P. WIN-" at right.

main_text.l: ipsorum Ordinum Leovardiæ solutus est, cursuque præcipiti, velut
flexu syderum solet, cum fragore se aperiens futura tempestas proce-
rum ingenia dissociavit. Scribit Iodocius, isto conventu de rescindendo
præsertim fœdere Arembergium egisse, Delegatisque Ordinum,
modo renuntiatum fœderi foret, læsi regis gratiam, & restitutionem
in integrum addixisse. Cæterum mihi res patriæ evolventi
penitius, secus notatum, Arembergiumq; nullo pacis consilio, militem hoc tempore
clàm collegisse, eundemq; adultâ demum ætate in speciem
dimissum, ac edicto Senatus regij coërcitum, Provincialium

page.notes: The date numerals "cIↄ. Iↄ." and "LXVII." stand in the right margin beside the first two lines; they are read as MD and LXVII, with the first set in the printed form. The ornament below "Finis Libri Primi." is a woodcut headpiece with no text. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
